svg.text: How claude-brain remembers, and how it recalls
One local encoder turns text into meaning-vectors. Saving and searching both pass through it, so a question lands next to the conversations that answer it.
WRITE · EVERY TIME A SESSION ENDS
vectors held hot in RAM by the recall server
≈5 ms server-side · ≈54 ms end to end · one embedding + one matrix product · no network, no API key
bge-small-en-v1.5 · 33M parameters · runs on your CPU via fastembed
High in both lists wins: paraphrases and exact errors both land.
